A01.summary: Shown/stated in the community contract: XML DialogueTree has NameField and named nodes, pages, entry conditions, randomized alternatives, fact reveals, loop-local and persistent setters, targets and option lists. Options can require/cancel loop conditions, persistent conditions or known log facts. The builder merges options for matching node names, adds new nodes, and patches reused option lists on a later update. Signs and recordings change the prompt by NameField. No vanilla full dialogue corpus or relationship weights were acquired.

yairpg.takeaway: Namespace conversation IDs, distinguish condition lifetimes and bind fact grants to reached nodes. Existing speech must not be replaced by an additive topic patch.

A02.summary: Shown: text_schema.xsd describes parent-linked TextBlocks and fact reveals requiring particular read block IDs. shiplog_schema.xsd separately describes entries, rumor/source edges and exploration facts. The reader structure and log summary are separate content owners. Full original narrative wording, every clue and DLC reels are unread.

yairpg.takeaway: Record which text blocks support a reading. A discovered thread may preserve an unanswered question without forcing a quest sequence.

A03.summary: Shown: Main extends OWML ModBehaviour, uses Unity components, Harmony patches, scene load/unload hooks and delayed work. Config modules describe bodies/props/systems. ConditionalsManager listens to dialogue/persistent/log events and batches checks in LateUpdate, disabling itself when idle. This is community extension architecture over external game types; the proprietary engine loop is not visible.

yairpg.takeaway: Queue condition-dependent work until an explicit settlement boundary. Avoid recursively mutating shared state during event publication.

A04.summary: Shown: NewHorizonsData owns save.json with a Profiles dictionary keyed by the active game profile; fallback naming handles unavailable profile lookup. It stores custom signals/frequencies, unread fact IDs, popup receipts and characters talked to. A SaveCurrentGame postfix writes extension state; ResetGame resets it. Load failure creates a fresh extension file, and save exceptions log errors. No schema version, atomic publication, backup recovery or vanilla save format was established.

yairpg.takeaway: Keep extension data bound to profile identity. Preserve unread/rejected data on load failure and declare compatibility rather than silently replacing it.

A05.summary: Shown: DialogueBuilder can create attention points, remote triggers and player-tracking zones for authored speakers; a persistent condition can prevent creating a conversation. This does not prove an NPC planner, social utility simulation or the DLC pursuer decision system. Those game AI internals are unread.

yairpg.takeaway: A remote interruption needs a valid contact channel and current condition. Attention behavior is presentation, not autonomous motivation.

A06.summary: Shown: log entries expose rumor names, photos and coverage-suppression controls; dialogue distinguishes talk/read/record prompts. The community builder inserts extra options before existing end/menu choices. Navigation, keyboard/controller behavior, accessibility and full-screen layout were not tested.

yairpg.takeaway: At desktop target 1366x768/1920x1080, keep known leads and selected evidence visible together; distinguish unread text from unexplored content. Mobile is deferred.

A07.summary: Shown/stated: JSON planet props reference XML dialogue; eight schema files cover JSON and XML contracts. Matching named nodes merge option lists, not arbitrary existing prose/effects; new nodes require reachable links. Unique prefixes reduce cross-mod name clashes. Guide says reused option lists need two frames before entering when loaded from code. This is an author guide, not fresh timing proof.

yairpg.takeaway: Validate dangling targets, duplicate IDs and namespace clashes before publishing a content pack. Model additive topics separately from overrides.

A08.summary: Shown: schema configs carry numeric limits/defaults; RevealBuilder uses a default observation distance of 2 when maxDistance is -1 and checks angle/collider semantics. ConditionalsManager caps consecutive reactive passes at 120. These are community settings, not a complete vanilla hazard/RNG balance audit. No XP curve, pity or big-number system is established.

yairpg.takeaway: Use concrete observation distance and channel limits. A recursion guard must report unresolved state rather than grant a reward.

A09.summary: Shown: the community TimeLoopController reacts to TriggerSupernova, checks the time-loop-enabled flag and kills after its own 50-second delay. This code is a mod controller, not evidence replacing the shipped 22-minute loop. System config can enable/disable the loop. No offline catch-up or entire dynamic solar-system timing read.

yairpg.takeaway: World-local loop settings and post-event grace are separate parameters. Knowledge of timing should inform a route, not auto-complete it.

A10.summary: Shown: EntryCondition includes a default entry; RequiredLogCondition makes learned facts unlock topics. shiplog separates rumor labels, direct facts and more-to-explore suppression. This supports staged authoring without a universal XP gate. Base-game tutorial sequence and player playtest results remain unread in this pass.

yairpg.takeaway: Let a clue expose a question and a new conversation topic. Reaching a log flag must not bypass physical requirements of the answer.

A11.summary: Shown: signs/recordings get distinct prompts; conversation tracking uses attention points; AddToExistingDialogue prepends options to keep the existing exit at the end. NewHorizonsData deduplicates one-time popup IDs and treats missing profile data as already read to avoid spam. These are inspected community behaviors, not full vanilla QoL claims.

yairpg.takeaway: Keep exit actions easy to find and separate notification acknowledgement from permanent knowledge.

A12.summary: Shown/indexed: custom signals/frequencies, profile-scoped popup history, talked-to-character achievements, cross-system warp/entry controls, translation, quantum props, dream-world props and dynamic volumes. Only custom data and condition/reveal interactions were read in depth. No exhaustive vanilla systems or DLC corpus claimed.

yairpg.takeaway: Separate a learned signal, a contact route and a usable destination. Additional worlds should state their allowed outside-item and clock policies.
